note: G0 governance baseline. Every OPEN risk has an accountable role, fail-closed containment/recovery and explicit design Case IDs, but no risk is closed without indexed E3/E4 product evidence.

records.containmentRecovery: Deny the entire physical domain when provenance or peer isolation is unknown; retain all members until authoritative domain and peer-DMA evidence are restored.
Abort before reset on affected-set uncertainty; quarantine the whole affected set after execution drift or failure and restore only through verified recovery.
Quarantine the bundle on missing clean-state proof; perform a qualified reset and state probe or retire the device from the supported pool.
A CAS conflict or stale epoch aborts every side effect; retain the current lease and reconcile from the authority before retry.
Rollback the whole request in reverse order; quarantine any member lacking cleanup proof and never commit a partial VM assignment.
Keep the bundle leased or quarantined until unmap, IOTLB and IRQ teardown evidence is complete; power-cycle or retire it when clean state cannot be proven.
Reject admission and recompute guest memory holes; attach only after every authoritative reserved range is compatible with the selected mapping.
Exclude the incompatible candidate and recompute the whole selection; keep the VM stopped when no ABI-compatible solution exists.
Reject before launch or rollback observed post-boot drift; invalidate the profile until the joint firmware and QEMU resource plan is requalified.
On source-host loss keep the VM stopped and preserve the ownership claim; forbid cross-host reassignment until an explicit clean source release at the current logical epoch.
Treat QEMU disappearance as unknown device state; retain the lease and quarantine until current-generation cleanup and reset evidence is committed.
Hide expansion ROM by default; reject unknown or changed ROM content and disable the profile until an approved hash is reissued.
Remove an unhealthy device and its affected bundle from every pool; quarantine and require health plus reset recovery before readmission.
Hide ATS, PRI and PASID by default; quarantine after uncertain invalidation and expose only an exact profile with complete teardown proof.
Deny peer DMA for every unqualified backend profile; quarantine the physical domain after any unexpected peer mapping or DMA observation.
Reject snapshot, suspend and migration requests before state changes; leave VM definition, assignment and lease unchanged and audit the denial.
Reject runtime PCI mutation at API, scheduler, launcher and QMP boundaries; stop and quarantine the assignment if an unexpected mutation is observed.
Reject a hard-locality violation or remove an out-of-envelope profile from support; reschedule only after locality and workload counters meet the qualified policy.
Invalidate every capability that depends on changed or revoked catalog content; disable the exact profile until signed requalification succeeds.
Remove unsupported guest, driver or OEM combinations from the signed support profile and deny new starts until workload requalification.
Deny any BAR sharing a host resource page with unrelated resources; restore eligibility only after exclusive-page provenance is available.
Make the admitted ReBAR size immutable and reject guest writes; stop and invalidate the assignment if observed resources diverge from the plan.
Allocate PF, VFs and reset dependencies as one policy closure; quarantine the full functional set after lifecycle or ownership uncertainty.
Pin PME ownership in the qualified profile and deny unsupported low-power transitions; restore only after host and guest IRQ state is reconciled.
Preflight the complete topology and effective device ceiling; keep the VM stopped at limit plus one and require a new profile before increasing the limit.
Reject unmanaged launch or mutation endpoints; terminate and quarantine any unauthorized attach, then reconcile the lease and audit trail.
Deny the exact platform profile on unknown IOMMU or interrupt-remapping behavior; re-enable only after bare-metal requalification.
Treat every requester-ID alias and legacy subtree as one translation domain; deny the component when alias provenance is incomplete.
Expand and reserve every multifunction, PF/VF and vendor functional dependency before admission; quarantine all members after partial state change.
Persist requested and resolved layout plus provenance; reject import or registration drift until an operator explicitly accepts a newly qualified ABI.
Reject invalid firmware and motherboard combinations in schema, API and launcher; leave the VM definition unchanged on denial.
Label stock-QEMU topology as an approximation and reject strict VMware ABI requests unless a qualified custom machine is available.
Use full-tree exact planning and mandatory-BAR assertions; reject unsatisfied or timed-out plans without greedy fallback.
Reject mandatory large-BAR devices that the legacy profile cannot allocate; never treat enumeration without assigned BARs as success.
Deny every device in a component with unknown native shadow-domain provenance; use userspace estimation only for differential diagnostics.
Pin required span, firmware aperture and QEMU floor separately; reject any observed runtime window or BAR mismatch and invalidate the profile.
Expose no runtime-hotplug capability, slot or capacity; reject every bypass path and quarantine if guest topology changes unexpectedly.
Resolve dependency, action, reset and qualification closure before capable; invalidate the whole decision on any missing or changed member fact.
Keep desired, effective and disposition states separate; rollback partial owner changes and require maintenance or boot reconciliation before retry.
